title: Battery Critical notification could benefit from a real-time countdown
line: The Battery Critical notification now counts down the seconds left before the system sleeps, hibernates or shuts down.
explanation: When the battery reaches the critical level and the critical action is sleep, hibernate or shut down, powerdevil starts a 60 second single-shot timer and shows a persistent notification with the fixed text "The system will hibernate in 60 seconds.". The text was set once and never changed, so after 50 seconds it still said 60. A second one-second timer now rewrites the notification text with the time left on the critical battery timer (plural-aware strings), and it is stopped together with the main timer when the notification is cancelled, the power cord is plugged in or the action runs.

commits.message:
daemon: Count down the seconds in the Battery Critical notification

The Battery Critical notification always said the system would sleep,
hibernate or shut down "in 60 seconds", even as that time ran out. It
now updates every second to show how many seconds are actually left.

BUG: 491632

media.caption: Before: about 2 s and about 48 s after the battery hit 3%, the notification still says "in 60 seconds".
After: the same notification 3 s and about 54 s in, now showing 57 and 6 seconds left.
